purpose: One iOS application containing the existing SIFAS game, an in-process Elichika Go server, and the existing Python/web editing tools
deployment_target: iOS 13.0 or a higher documented minimum required by the final signed dependency closure

go_abi.memory: Every result is a separately allocated UTF-8 JSON string; caller must use ElichikaServerFree. Input strings are copied and never modified.

start_options.ready_token: Random per-launch native-host readiness token; never logged
start_options.web_token: Random per-launch trusted embedded web UI token; never logged

result.state: starting, ready, stopping, stopped, or error
result.endpoint: Actual owned game HTTP endpoint, or null
result.error: null, or an object with code and specific safe message

go_abi.readiness: ready only after real game routes and SQLite/data initialization succeed and the owned listener is accepting requests; expose token-authenticated /__elichika/health
go_abi.lifecycle: No os.Exit, process spawn, global cwd changes or application signal ownership; one Go runtime. Start/Stop/Status and command operations must return promptly or report an asynchronous job. Unknown commands fail explicitly.

python_host.startup: Isolated iOS CPython 3.13 on a serial worker; no Python signal handlers or runtime package installation. Prepare and validate writable payload first, start real Go server, start authenticated loopback admin/tools services; combined readiness requires all advertised components actually work.
python_host.filesystem: App-owned resources/data/packs roots; do not change the Unity process cwd or globally monkeypatch shared Python/OS state. Import/export through UIKit document bridges.

game_host.layout: Monolithic Unity 2018 main executable; no UnityFramework
game_host.startup: Audited SIFAS readiness gate with no second UIApplicationMain or Unity runtime; preserve original delegate/endpoint/RSA/FOV/orientation/duplicate/material/Settings behavior. No unbounded blocking of the main thread.
game_host.lifecycle: Foreground recovery and recoverable interrupted work. Game and tools may switch screens; do not claim indefinite background execution.

validation.first_compile: Real iphoneos arm64 and iphonesimulator builds of actual Go+SQLite and native host; no fake server
validation.simulator: Separate probe application may use fake game lifecycle entry points only; exercise real server, payload, encrypted API and tool services
validation.candidate: Real game IPA with audited load command additions and complete ad-hoc signing, explicit REQUIRES_USER_RESIGN for SideStore
validation.preservation: All original game content and executable code/section addresses preserved except audited startup load additions; signing metadata changes explicitly allowlisted and verified
validation.truth: Compile/probe success does not establish physical iPhone/iPad game or full modding parity; report exact passed gates and concrete remaining failures
validation.archive: Existing upload and queued resume remain unchanged; no fabricated complete Archive config and no bypass of production APK/Mac publication gates
